Qin.name: Ying Zheng
Qin.title: First Emperor of Qin
Qin.note: Died on tour at Shaqiu in 210 BCE.
Qin.note_zh: 前210年出巡途中死于沙丘。

Qin.name: Huhai
Qin.title: Second Emperor of Qin
Qin.note: Put on the throne by Zhao Gao and Li Si; forced to kill himself by Zhao Gao.
Qin.note_zh: 由赵高、李斯矫诏拥立，后被赵高逼迫自杀。

Qin.name: Ziying
Qin.title: Ziying, King of Qin
Qin.note: Ruled 46 days with the reduced title of king, then surrendered to Liu Bang.
Qin.note_zh: 去帝号称秦王，在位46天后向刘邦投降。

Xiongnu.name: Touman
Xiongnu.title: Touman Chanyu
Xiongnu.note: The first known chanyu; when his reign began is not known. Killed by his son Modu.
Xiongnu.note_zh: 已知最早的单于，即位年份不详，被儿子冒顿所杀。

Xiongnu.name: Modu
Xiongnu.title: Modu Chanyu
Xiongnu.note: United the steppe and built the Xiongnu empire.
Xiongnu.note_zh: 统一草原，建立强大的匈奴帝国。

qin-baiyue.note: The figure is traditional. Yue guerrillas killed Tu Sui at first; Qin won after the Lingqu canal was dug to carry supplies.
qin-baiyue.note_zh: 数字为传统说法。越人游击战曾击杀主将屠睢，秦开凿灵渠解决补给后才取胜。

great-wall-qin.note: Qin drove the Xiongnu out of the Ordos, then used the soldiers and convicts to build the wall.
great-wall-qin.note_zh: 秦军把匈奴逐出河套，随后用士兵和刑徒修筑长城。

dazexiang.note: The rising succeeded at first and Chen Sheng made himself King of Zhangchu at Chen, but Qin's Zhang Han crushed it within six months.
dazexiang.note_zh: 起义初期节节胜利，陈胜在陈县称王，国号张楚，但半年内即被秦将章邯镇压。
dazexiang.losses: Chen Sheng killed by his own driver in 208 BCE
dazexiang.losses_zh: 前208年陈胜被车夫庄贾杀害

liu-bang-pei.note: The townspeople killed the Qin magistrate and opened the gates to Liu Bang.
liu-bang-pei.note_zh: 沛县父老杀死县令，开城迎刘邦。

julu.note: Xiang Yu crossed the river, sank his boats and smashed the cooking pots so his men could not retreat (破釜沉舟).
julu.note_zh: 项羽渡河后凿沉船只、砸破炊具，以示有进无退，即“破釜沉舟”。
julu.losses: Wang Li captured; Zhang Han later surrendered with 200,000 men
julu.losses_zh: 王离被俘；章邯其后率20万秦军投降

routes.name: Qin Great Wall
routes.summary: Meng Tian joined and extended the old Qin, Zhao and Yan walls into one line from Lintao to Liaodong, the 'Ten-Thousand-Li Wall' (route approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 蒙恬把秦、赵、燕旧长城连接扩建，西起临洮、东至辽东，号称“万里长城”（走向为大致示意）。

routes.name: Qin conquest of the Baiyue
routes.summary: Qin armies went south through Chu lands and, after cutting the Lingqu canal to link the Xiang and Li rivers, took Lingnan and founded three commanderies.
routes.summary_zh: 秦军经楚地南下，开凿灵渠沟通湘江与漓江后攻取岭南，设南海、桂林、象三郡。

routes.name: The First Emperor's last tour
routes.summary: He travelled down the Yangtze to Kuaiji and north along the coast to Zhifu, then died at Shaqiu. His body was carried home via Jiuyuan and the Straight Road.
routes.summary_zh: 秦始皇沿长江东下至会稽，再沿海北上到芝罘，在沙丘病逝；遗体经九原、直道运回咸阳。

routes.name: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang's rising
routes.summary: The rebels took Qi and Chen, where Chen Sheng became king; his general Zhou Wen then pushed west through the Hangu Pass to Xi, near the capital, before being driven back.
routes.summary_zh: 起义军攻占蕲县、陈县，陈胜在陈称王；部将周文率军西进，入函谷关直抵咸阳附近的戏，随后被击退。

routes.name: Xiang Yu marches to Julu and Guanzhong
routes.summary: The Chu army went north to relieve Julu, won there, took Zhang Han's surrender and turned west through the Hangu Pass to Hongmen, near Xianyang, which he reached at the turn of 207/206 BCE.
routes.summary_zh: 楚军北上救巨鹿，大破秦军，接受章邯投降后西进入函谷关，约在前207年末至前206年初抵达咸阳附近的鸿门。

routes.name: Liu Bang enters Guanzhong
routes.summary: Liu Bang went west by a southern road through Nanyang and the Wu Pass and reached Bashang first; Ziying surrendered Xianyang to him.
routes.summary_zh: 刘邦经南阳、武关西进，抢先到达灞上，秦王子婴出城向他投降。

people.name: Li Si
people.known_for: Qin chancellor and Legalist who standardised Chinese writing as small seal script.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝丞相、法家人物，主持以小篆统一文字。

works.title: Petition against the Expulsion of Guest Officials

people.name: Xu Fu
people.known_for: Court magician sent by the First Emperor to sail east in search of the elixir of immortality; he never returned.
people.known_for_zh: 受秦始皇派遣率船队东渡寻找长生不老药，一去不返。

people.name: Widow Qing of Ba
people.known_for: Wealthy businesswoman who ran a cinnabar mining enterprise and was honoured by the First Emperor.
people.known_for_zh: 经营丹砂矿业致富的女企业家，受到秦始皇礼遇。

people.name: Qin Shi Huang
people.known_for: First Emperor who unified China in 221 BC and standardized writing, coinage and measures.
people.known_for_zh: 统一六国，建立中国第一个中央集权王朝，统一文字度量衡。

people.name: Meng Tian
people.known_for: Qin general who drove back the Xiongnu and oversaw the building of the Great Wall.
people.known_for_zh: 北击匈奴，主持修筑万里长城与直道。

people.name: Meng Yi
people.known_for: Trusted minister of the First Emperor and brother of Meng Tian, executed after the succession plot.
people.known_for_zh: 秦始皇亲信上卿，蒙恬之弟，被胡亥赐死。

people.name: Zhao Gao
people.known_for: Eunuch who manipulated the Qin succession and famously 'called a deer a horse'.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝宦官，矫诏立胡亥，“指鹿为马”，祸乱朝政。

people.name: Wang Ben
people.known_for: Son of Wang Jian who conquered Wei, Yan and Qi, completing Qin's unification.
people.known_for_zh: 王翦之子，灭魏、燕、齐，完成秦统一。

people.name: Fusu
people.known_for: Eldest son of the First Emperor, forced to suicide by a forged edict.
people.known_for_zh: 秦始皇长子，因直谏被派监军上郡，遭矫诏自尽。

people.name: Cheng Miao
people.known_for: Qin prison official traditionally credited with creating the clerical script.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝狱吏，相传整理创制隶书。

people.name: Gao Jianli
people.known_for: Zhu musician and friend of Jing Ke who tried to kill the First Emperor with his lead-weighted instrument.
people.known_for_zh: 善击筑，荆轲好友，以筑击秦始皇未中被杀。

people.name: Chen Sheng
people.known_for: Leader of the Dazexiang Uprising, the first major revolt against the Qin.
people.known_for_zh: 大泽乡起义领袖，“王侯将相宁有种乎”。

people.name: Wu Guang
people.known_for: Co-leader of the Dazexiang Uprising with Chen Sheng.
people.known_for_zh: 与陈胜共同发动大泽乡起义。

people.name: Xiang Liang
people.known_for: Chu noble who raised rebellion against Qin at Kuaiji and mentored his nephew Xiang Yu.
people.known_for_zh: 起兵会稽反秦，项羽叔父，定陶战死。

people.name: Zhang Han
people.known_for: Qin general who led convict armies to crush early rebels before surrendering to Xiang Yu.
people.known_for_zh: 率骊山刑徒军镇压起义，后降项羽。

people.name: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
people.known_for: Peasant-born rebel who defeated Xiang Yu and founded the Han dynasty in 202 BCE.
people.known_for_zh: 出身布衣，击败项羽，于前202年建立汉朝。

people.name: Empress Lü Zhi
people.known_for: Liu Bang's empress and later empress dowager, the first woman to wield supreme power in imperial China.
people.known_for_zh: 汉高祖皇后，临朝称制，中国首位掌握最高权力的女性。

people.name: Xiao He
people.known_for: Liu Bang's first chancellor who secured supplies, preserved Qin records and drafted the Han legal code.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相，保障军需、收秦图籍，制定《九章律》。

people.name: Zhang Liang
people.known_for: Strategist whose counsel guided Liu Bang to victory; one of the Three Heroes of early Han.
people.known_for_zh: 运筹帷幄的谋士，辅佐刘邦取天下，汉初三杰之一。

people.name: Han Xin
people.known_for: Brilliant general who won Liu Bang's key campaigns, famed for fighting with backs to the river; later executed.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初名将，背水一战，为刘邦夺取天下，后遭诛杀。

people.name: Cao Shen
people.known_for: Second Han chancellor who kept Xiao He's policies unchanged, a model of Huang-Lao non-interference.
people.known_for_zh: 继萧何为相，萧规曹随，奉行黄老无为之治。

people.name: Chen Ping
people.known_for: Crafty strategist of Liu Bang and later chancellor who helped crush the Lü clan in 180 BCE.
people.known_for_zh: 刘邦谋士，后任丞相，与周勃共诛诸吕。

people.name: Fan Kuai
people.known_for: Former dog butcher and Liu Bang's brother-in-law who rescued him at the Feast at Hong Gate.
people.known_for_zh: 屠狗出身的猛将，鸿门宴上护卫刘邦脱险。

people.name: Lu Jia
people.known_for: Early Han thinker and envoy who urged Liu Bang to rule by Confucian virtue in his New Discourses.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初思想家、使节，著《新语》劝高祖以仁义治国。

people.name: Zhao Tuo
people.known_for: Qin general who founded the kingdom of Nanyue in the far south and ruled it for some seventy years.
people.known_for_zh: 秦将，建立南越国，统治岭南约七十年。

people.name: Zhang Cang
people.known_for: Han chancellor and mathematician credited with editing the Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art and setting the calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相、数学家，相传曾整理《九章算术》并定历法。

works.title: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art

capitals.name: Xianyang
capitals.note: Capital since 350 BCE; seat of the first empire.
capitals.note_zh: 自公元前350年起为秦都，第一个帝国的都城。
